_readme: Researched detail for the away trips, applied by scripts/apply_trip_details.py.
This file is in git on purpose. Unlike data/fcvino.sqlite3 — which holds your
friends' ratings and notes and stays out of the repo — these are public football
results. Keeping them here means the archive survives a lost database: enter the
trips once, and this file can rebuild every detail on any machine.
Match a trip on year + country. Every field except year and country is optional;
the script fills only columns that are currently empty unless you pass --overwrite,
so nothing you typed in Discord gets clobbered.
Goals are strings in the same format /trips add-goals accepts:
'source' is ignored by the script and exists so a claim can be checked later.
Anything that cannot be verified should be left out rather than guessed at.
